name: Semiconductor Fabrication Capacity
definition: Installed wafer fabrication capacity located within the state's territory, normalised to a 0-100 stress scale where 100 is maximum dependency, that is minimum domestic capacity per unit of domestic compute demand. The axis measures fabrication located in the state, not corporate nationality of the operator: a foreign-owned fab on domestic soil is domestic capacity for substrate purposes, because the question is where the wafers can physically be made.
why_not_derivable: There is no arithmetic route to this axis from the axes already published. WSE, CSE, REE, FPE, ODI, ESE and RGD measure water, cable, rare earth, platform, operator, electricity and region density. None is a proxy for fabrication capacity, and deriving one from them would produce a number that varies with inputs it has no causal relation to.

big_gate.minimum_states_derivation: 27 of 35 = 0.7714, which clears 0.75. 26 of 35 = 0.7429, which does not. The audit protocol was drafted against a 26-state bar and that figure is wrong: a source covering exactly 26 states would have been read as meeting the threshold and unlocked the axis below its own gate. Caught by scripts/prove_axis_sfc_contract.py, which checks the scaffold's stated minimum against the ratio it claims to implement. The ratio governs; the count is derived from it and never typed independently.
big_gate.rule: The axis is publishable only when at least 75 percent of the sample carries a value admitted by the ingestion contract. Below that it is withheld with the cause stated per state, never imputed, per D-007.
big_gate.on_failure: WITHHELD WITH CAUSE. The axis is absent from the composite and the cause is published per state.

ingestion_contract.note: Every clause below is executable. The first version of this scaffold stated the unit, announced-capacity and publisher rules in prose and enforced only coverage, so a dataset measured in revenue would have counted toward the threshold and unlocked the axis on a number that measures something else.
ingestion_contract.refused_publishers: Aggregators are refused per D-015 and L-007: Statista, Wikipedia, Medium, Substack. A capacity figure must come from the body that measures it or the operator that reports it.
ingestion_contract.aggregate_rows_refused: A row naming anything that is not a state in the sample is refused. Rest of World, EU, Europe and Asia-Pacific cannot stand in for the states they contain: an aggregate admitted as one record would satisfy the coverage gate while leaving every state inside it unmeasured.
ingestion_contract.announced_capacity: Recorded separately and never summed into installed capacity. A record flagged includes_announced_capacity is refused. A fab that does not yet make wafers makes no wafers.
ingestion_contract.baseline_identity: Two sources may be merged only on proof that their 200mm-equivalent conversion is identical. A dataset for Asia on one baseline and a dataset for Europe on another produces a column that is not comparable across its own rows, and the gate cannot detect that from the values alone.

source_audit_protocol.status: PHASE 1, 2 AND 3 EXECUTED. Phase 3 closed 2026-08-14. Axis remains WITHHELD.
source_audit_protocol.provenance_of_this_plan: Supplied by the operator 2026-08-07. The leads below are pointers to audit, not findings. None has been retrieved, opened or verified by this repository, and nothing here may be cited as evidence that such a dataset exists.

phase_1_policy_network.vector: Policy institutes synthesise capacity data; they do not count wafers. The objective is their appendices, bibliographies and data-licensing disclosures, to reach the primary source behind their charts.
phase_1_policy_network.target_unverified: Interface, formerly Stiftung Neue Verantwortung (SNV), Berlin.
named_leads_unverified: Jan-Peter Kleinhans and Julia Hess, 'Understanding the Global Chip Shortages' (2021)
Jan-Peter Kleinhans, testimony to the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission (2022), reported to chart front-end capacity in wspm segmented by process node
Jan-Peter Kleinhans and John Lee, 'Europe's dependence on Chinese semiconductor manufacturing' (2022)
phase_1_policy_network.what_to_extract: Go to the methodology and data citations behind any chart measuring wspm, not the executive summary. Determine whether a slice of the SEMI World Fab Forecast was licensed, and whether a derived open dataset was published alongside. Check Zenodo and GitHub for a supplementary csv or an analytical pipeline.
phase_1_policy_network.go_no_go: If the dataset aggregates states into Rest of World or Europe, it fails the aggregate-rows clause and cannot reach 27 states however complete it looks. Abandon Phase 1 and proceed to Phase 2.

phase_2_industry_fallback.vector: Extract capacity from tier-one industry reporting, filtering strictly for the unit. The risk is marketing material stated as measurement.
targets_unverified: SIA and BCG joint supply-chain reports, for methodology tables broken down by state rather than by region
TrendForce and IC Insights, scanned only for wafer starts per month in 200mm-equivalents
phase_2_industry_fallback.reject_on_sight: Any table measuring market share by revenue, tallying raw fab count, or listing announced but unbuilt capacity. These are the refused_units and the announced_capacity clause, and the gate enforces both.
phase_2_industry_fallback.baseline_check: Verify each source's definition of a 200mm-equivalent before merging anything. Sources may not be combined without proving the conversion identical.

source_audit_protocol.outcome_rule: The axis stays WITHHELD until a single source, on one consistent definition, is admitted for at least 27 of the 35 states. Stitching partial sources with different units is how a coverage gate is cleared on paper while the axis measures nothing.

executed.method: Web search and direct fetch of publisher pages. Every finding below was read from a retrieved page, never inferred. Where a page did not render its data tables the finding says so rather than assuming.

findings.target: SEMI, the body that measures wafer capacity
findings.verdict: REFUSED as published, ADMISSIBLE if purchased
findings.detail: SEMI's PUBLIC output reports capacity by REGION, not by state. Its own press release gives 200mm shares as China 22 percent, Japan 16, Taiwan 15, 'Europe & Mideast' 14, 'America' 14. 'Europe & Mideast' and 'America' are aggregate rows and are refused by the aggregate_rows_refused clause. The shares are percentages, not wspm, and are refused by refused_units. The go_no_go written into phase_1 anticipated exactly this and it is what happened. The PAID World Fab Forecast is facility-level, line by line, and would satisfy the contract on unit and granularity. It is a commercial subscription and its licence must be read before any figure derived from it is published under CC-BY-NC.
findings.cost_to_admit: subscription purchase plus a licence review by COUNSEL

findings.target: OECD Semiconductor Production Database, 'The Chip Landscape'
findings.verdict: STRONGEST LEAD. Not yet admitted: the data tables did not render in the fetch.
findings.detail: The publisher's own abstract states the paper maps 'global semiconductor wafer fabrication capacity BY ECONOMY, process node density, process technology and business model, building on the newly assembled OECD Semiconductor Production Database'. Capacity in this literature is reported in wafer starts per month on 8-inch equivalents, which IS the scaffold's canonical_unit wspm_200mm_equivalent: 8 inch is 200mm. By economy rather than by region is the clause SEMI's public output fails. OECD is an intergovernmental statistical body with published methodology, not a content aggregator, so D-015 does not refuse it on its face. It does however compile commercial sources including SEMI and TechInsights, which raises the baseline_identity question rather than settling it.
unverified: how many of the 35 sample states carry a value
whether smaller producers are folded into a residual region
the licence terms for redistribution of derived values
whether the 8-inch conversion is stated and identical across economies

findings.target: Content aggregators encountered during the search
findings.verdict: REFUSED ON SIGHT under D-015 and L-007
findings.detail: Statista appeared twice in search results with figures that look authoritative. It is named in refused_publishers. Recorded here so a later reader does not rediscover it and mistake it for a source.

findings.target: OECD Policy Paper 188, 'The Chip Landscape', read from the PDF in Digital Twin R&D
findings.verdict: REFUSED ON COVERAGE. Decisive. The lead is closed, not pending.
findings.unit_confirmed: The paper states verbatim: 'The production capacity of a fab is measured in wafer starts per month (WSPM) in 8-inch (8'') equivalents (EQ)'. That IS the scaffold's canonical_unit wspm_200mm_equivalent with no conversion. The unit was never the problem.
findings.aggregate_rows_present: RoW appears twice, Europe three times
findings.why_this_closes_the_lead: The go_no_go clause written into phase_1 said: 'If the dataset aggregates states into Rest of World or Europe, it fails the aggregate-rows clause and cannot reach 27 states however complete it looks.' It does both. It names 15 of the 35 and folds the remainder into RoW and Europe. No amount of careful extraction reaches 27 from a source that covers 15. The clause predicted the outcome and the outcome is what it predicted.
findings.what_survives: OECD remains the correct TAXONOMY authority: the 8-inch-equivalent definition, the node-density and business-model dimensions are directly reusable and are cited in Chips, Nodes and Wafers (OECD 2024). Use the paper for the method and the definitions, never as the coverage source.

executed.verdict: The axis stays WITHHELD. No source has been admitted for any state, so coverage remains 0 of 35 against a minimum of 27. This is a finding, not a gap to fill: D-007 forbids imputation and the outcome_rule forbids stitching partial sources.
executed.next_action_single: Retrieve the OECD Semiconductor Production Database tables directly and count the economies. One number decides this axis: if it carries 27 or more of the 35 sample states on one stated 8-inch-equivalent definition, the axis is admissible and v9.0 is unblocked. If it folds smaller producers into a residual region, it fails the aggregate-rows clause and the only remaining route is the paid SEMI World Fab Forecast.

source_audit_protocol.verdict: The axis stays WITHHELD. Coverage 0 of 35 against a minimum of 27. Both public leads are now CLOSED rather than pending: SEMI's public output reports regions, and the OECD paper covers 15 of the 35 states and folds the rest into RoW and Europe. The only remaining admissible route is the paid SEMI World Fab Forecast, which is facility-level, plus a COUNSEL licence review before any derived figure ships under CC-BY-NC. That is a purchase decision, not a research task.
source_audit_protocol.next_action_single: Decide whether to buy the SEMI World Fab Forecast. There is no free source that clears 27 of 35 on one definition. Until that decision, SFC stays WITHHELD WITH CAUSE and v9.0 does not build on this axis.

phase_3_retrieval.closes: the standing caveat that no lead had been retrieved, opened or verified by this repository. Both leads have now been opened and read against the ingestion contract.

sources_opened.file: Digital Twin R&D/GEOGRAPHICAL DISTRIBUTION OF WAFER FABRICATION CAPACITY_semicondutor axis.pdf
sources_opened.publisher: OECD, drawing on SEMI World Fab Forecast and TechInsights WFW
sources_opened.unit_verdict: ADMISSIBLE. 8-inch is 200mm, so the source unit equals the canonical wspm_200mm_equivalent. This is the one contract clause the source clears.

sources_opened.file: Digital Twin R&D/vulnerabilities in the semicondutor supply chain_OECD.pdf
sources_opened.unit_verdict: REFUSED. Two occurrences of capacity and no WSPM figures. It is a supply-chain risk paper, not a capacity dataset.

coverage_measured.note: China and Chinese Taipei carry the largest figures. China is not in the 35-state sample. Even reading every named economy generously the count does not exceed 6.

closed_world_assumption_tested.hypothesis: If the underlying fab database were a global census, a state absent from it would carry a MEASURED zero capacity rather than a missing value, and the axis would unlock at full coverage.
evidence: 'Neither of the datasets are fully complete, correct and accurate' (p.1232)
'missing information, coverage biases and inaccuracies can be expected' (p.1233)
closed_world_assumption_tested.reading: Absence from an admittedly uneven dataset is not a measured zero. Treating it as one would convert a coverage bias into a stress score of 100 for every unlisted state, which is imputation wearing a measurement's clothes and is refused by D-007.

further_contract_failures: Most figures are disaggregated per chip type, not a single installed_capacity_wspm per state.
A large share of the reported figures are UPCOMING capacity, refused outright by the announced_capacity clause.
No row carries process_nodes_covered, reference_year and per-state provenance in the required shape.
phase_3_retrieval.verdict: REFUSE. The axis remains WITHHELD WITH CAUSE. The gate worked: a source measured in the right unit but covering 4 of 35 states was refused on coverage rather than admitted on unit.

coverage.audit_note: cited remains 0 because no state cleared the full ingestion contract. Four states carry an admissible-unit figure but fail the per-state required_fields and provenance clauses. See source_audit_protocol.phase_3_retrieval.
